clause: 3. UTILITIES: Tenant pays for gas and electricity; landlord pays for water.
Tenant may paint the bedroom walls with the landlord's approval.
The landlord will fix any heating problem within 48 hours of being told.
Rent receipts will be provided on request.
7. KEYS: Tenant will receive two keys and must return them when moving out.
The landlord will return the deposit with interest as required by state law.
Tenant may have a small vegetable garden in the backyard.
Landlord must give 30 days notice before any change to the house rules.
Tenant may break the lease without penalty if called to active military duty.
Bicycles may be stored in the basement storage room.
4. ACCESS: The property manager keeps a key and may let himself in day or night.
The tenant agrees to forfeit the deposit if the lease is not renewed.
Resident shall pay a $50 fee every time a maintenance request is made.
All appliance breakdowns are the renter's problem to fix and pay for.
The renter may not join or organize any tenant association.
Owner bears no responsibility for theft, flooding or mold, regardless of cause.
If rent is three days late, the owner may enter and take the tenant's furniture as payment.
The landlord may end this lease with 3 days notice if he decides to sell the house.
Rent will increase by 20 percent every three months.
Any complaint must be settled by an arbitrator chosen by the landlord, and the tenant gives up going to court.
